api_sketch: Add a pytest marker (e.g. egglog) and tests under tests/ for gdk9.egglog_bridge that skip cleanly when the optional extra is absent. CI matrix/job installs gdk9-cli[egglog] via pip install '.[egglog]' (extra name confirmed in gdk9 pyproject: egglog = ["egglog>=13.0.0"]). Default CI without the extra stays green; optional job runs bridge tests green with the extra.
non_goals: No new egglog rewrite maths or implication semantics
No KeySuite Phase B adapter work
Implementation lands in ao3575911/gdk9 via the GDk9 bot — not in this r2s artefact PR
acceptance: pytest marker skips cleanly when egglog is not installed (no false red on default CI)
CI job/matrix entry with pip install '.[egglog]' runs egglog_bridge tests green
Main default matrix without the extra remains green
docs/SPIKE-egglog.md notes the CI path (marker + optional job)
security_notes: No secrets, tokens, or credentials in workflows or tests
Optional dependency only from PyPI package egglog (gdk9-cli[egglog] extra)
Board claim/evidence strings are untrusted data only
first_pr_scope: In ao3575911/gdk9 only: workflow and/or tox/pytest marker plus minimal tests for egglog_bridge. No maths, packaging, or unrelated feature work.
